8012.en: New City is where everyone eventually ends up!
8012.zh: 新城是所有人最終都會來到的地方！

8037.en: The Holy City of the Munk...

8043.zh: 傳說中的城市高踞在南方大海之外！

8047.zh: 傳聞恩帕尼在叢林裡建了一座巨大堡壘……

8048.zh: 烏克皮爾在荒野彼端，沿烏克皮爾山脈而行……

8052.zh: 可怕的巨人四處遊蕩，尋找美味的人類！

8056.zh: 傳聞可怕的女巫在陰暗山間出沒！

8058.en: The Witch Mountains are far to the east, north of the Ukpyr...

8062.en: The Magna Dane rules high in the Great Tower of Dionysceus!
8062.zh: 大丹恩高踞狄奧尼修斯巨塔統治！

8063.en: Dionysceus lies west of the Myrmideon Forest...
8063.zh: 狄奧尼修斯位於蜜爾米頓森林以西……

8082.zh: 墓窖之島藏著逝者與失落的秘密！

8087.en: The Tramontaine Forest, this side of the great Ukypr Mountains...
8087.zh: 特拉蒙泰森林，在烏克皮爾大山脈的這一側……

8093.en: The old Funhouse lies in the heart of the Rattkin Ruins...

8097.zh: 許多偉大的先祖長眠於此……

8102.zh: 傳聞那條龍夜裡飛越大海！

8103.zh: 據說南海之外住著一條巨龍！

9447.en: He gives his sword to preserve the kingdom of Gorn!
9447.zh: 他獻出劍來守護高恩王國！

9449.en: He is the protector of the Gorn domain, all of Orkogre Forest!
9449.zh: 他是高恩領地的守護者，整個奧高高森林！

9453.en: Murkatos dwells in the halls of Orkogre Castle!
9453.zh: 穆卡托斯住在奧高高城堡的廳堂裡！

9462.en: I fear that war shall soon ravage our lands!
9462.zh: 我擔心戰火即將蹂躪我們的土地！

9502.en: I heal the mortal wounds and mend the broken spirit...
9502.zh: 我治癒致命之傷，縫補破碎的心靈……

9503.en: I reside here in the hallowed halls of Thesminster Abbey...
9503.zh: 我住在希斯敏斯特修道院的聖堂裡……

9551.en: The statue has been here since the beginning of time!
9551.zh: 這座雕像從太初之時就立在這裡！

9556.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
9556.zh: 想行走夢土，就尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

9567.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, the city of the Holy Work...
9567.zh: 僧侶聖地這座聖城，正是聖工之城……

9568.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
9568.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地位於艾恩河以東……

9571.en: The diseased Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
9571.zh: 染病的丹恩家族之主，聖工的褻瀆者！

9573.en: He practices his unholy rituals from atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
9573.zh: 他在狄奧尼修斯之塔頂舉行邪穢儀式……

9576.en: The blasphemous scorn of Dane, may their souls burn forever!
9576.zh: 丹恩那群瀆神之徒，願他們的靈魂永遠燃燒！

9578.en: They spread their wickedness from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
9578.zh: 他們從邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

9581.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
9581.zh: 當心基馬斯·圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

9587.en: Dionysceus, the Unholy Tower, and House of the blaspheming Danes!
9587.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，邪穢之塔，瀆神丹恩眾之家！

9588.en: Beware, only the wicked walk through the unholy lands of Dane!
9588.zh: 當心，只有惡徒才會走過丹恩的邪穢之地！

9602.en: I am making a record of our history...
9602.zh: 我正在記錄我們的歷史……

9603.en: I reside here in New City...

9616.en: They were much like yourself, only different!...
9616.zh: 他們跟你很像，只是不太一樣！……

9617.en: The blueprints of the Old City, a part of my records on our history...
9617.zh: 舊城的藍圖，是我歷史紀錄的一部分……

9618.en: I no longer have the blueprints, only my history notes...
9618.zh: 藍圖已不在我手上，只剩歷史筆記……

9652.en: I come to the library to study, preferably without interruption!
9652.zh: 我來圖書館讀書，最好別來打擾我！

9653.en: The New City Library is all that remains of our written history...
9653.zh: 新城圖書館是我們文字歷史僅存的一切……

9656.en: They were very mysterious, we know little about them...
9656.zh: 他們非常神秘，我們對他們所知甚少……

9658.en: It is said they came from the mountains beyond the sea...
9658.zh: 據說他們來自大海彼端的群山……

9662.en: It is the sacred law created at the beginning of time!
9662.zh: 那是太初時創立的神聖律法！

9663.zh: 它在幾世紀前就失落了……

9666.en: They were much like yourself, only different!...
9666.zh: 他們跟你很像，只是不太一樣！……

9671.en: I have little time for such things!

9681.en: Don Barlone' is head of the family of Razuka!
9681.zh: 唐·巴隆內是拉祖卡家族的首領！

9686.en: Ratsputin, the gathering paw of the Razuka!
9686.zh: 鼠拉斯普丁，拉祖卡的召集之爪！

9688.en: He's making the rounds, I'm sure!

9693.en: I'm sure you'll bump into him sooner or later...

9697.en: Our forest home in the northern lands...
9697.zh: 我們在北方的森林家園……

9698.en: In the woods, down the valley, through the vale, over the mountains!
9698.zh: 在林間，沿山谷而下，穿過溪谷，翻越群山！

9706.en: The old Funhouse, perhaps best to stay away from there...
9706.zh: 老玩笑屋，最好別靠近那裡……

9711.en: The Razuka, the mighty paw of the land!
9711.zh: 拉祖卡，這片土地的威猛之爪！

9801.en: I am Lord Galiere, Defender of the Gorn Domains!
9801.zh: 我是加列爾領主，高恩領土的防衛者！

9802.en: I am Defender of the Gorn Domains!
9802.zh: 我是高恩領土的防衛者！

9803.en: We stand at the border of the lands of the Gorn Empire!
9803.zh: 我們正站在高恩帝國領土的邊界上！

9812.en: You'd best hurry with your news to the King!
9812.zh: 你最好趕快把消息呈給國王！

9816.en: Capt. Boerigard disappeared not long ago, and we fear for the worst!
9816.zh: 波利加德隊長不久前失蹤了，我們擔心最壞的已經發生！

9822.en: None but the loyal may walk the halls of Orkogre Castle!
9822.zh: 唯有忠誠者才能行走奧高高城堡的廳堂！

9823.en: Travel west and a little north through the forest from here...
9823.zh: 從這裡出發往西穿過森林，再稍偏北……

9832.en: The Gorn lands extend throughout all of Orkogre Forest...
9832.zh: 高恩的土地遍及整個奧高高森林……

9841.en: King Ulgar, Lord of the mighty Gorn Empire!
9841.zh: 烏爾加王，強大高恩帝國之主！

9843.en: He rules upon the throne of Orkogre Castle!
9843.zh: 他在奧高高城堡的王座上統治！

9851.en: Alas, poor wizard Murkatos, the betrayer betrayed!
9851.zh: 唉，可憐的法師穆卡托斯，叛徒反遭背叛！

9852.en: Poor Murkatos, once the great Wizard of Gorn, now a pile of bones...
9852.zh: 可憐的穆卡托斯，昔日高恩的偉大法師，如今只剩一堆白骨……

9862.en: Civil War has befallen the land of Gorn!

9903.en: We are but here in my humble shop...
9903.zh: 我們就在我這間簡陋小店裡……

9911.en: To find it you must pass through the land of dreams!
9911.zh: 想找到它，你必須穿越夢土！

9937.en: Perhaps you'd like to buy a bottle...

9938.en: I make it here, from my secret herbs and spices!
9938.zh: 我在這裡製作它，用我秘方的香草與香料！

9952.en: Perhaps you'd like to buy a few of my specialties!
9952.zh: 也許你想買幾樣我的招牌貨！

9957.en: From health to havoc, I have what you need!
9957.zh: 從健康到浩劫，你要的我都有！

9962.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, where thy dreams come true...
9962.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地，你的夢想成真之地……

9963.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
9963.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地位於艾恩河以東……

9966.en: It's been a long time since I've seen the good Father Rulae...
9966.zh: 我已經很久沒見到善良的魯萊神父了……

9968.en: The last time I saw Father Rulae, I was on a journey to New City...
9968.zh: 上次見到魯萊神父，是我前往新城的旅途中……

10001.en: I am Brother TShober, Guardian of Munkharama Bridge...
10001.zh: 我是喬伯修士，僧侶聖地橋的守護者……

10003.en: I guard the Bridge to Munkharama here at the Eyrn River...
10003.zh: 我在艾恩河畔守衛通往僧侶聖地的橋……

10031.en: All good brothers walk the holy path!
10031.zh: 所有良善修士皆行聖道！

10032.en: The rightful way of the holy work!

10033.en: Father Rulae of Thesminster Abbey can help you!
10033.zh: 希斯敏斯特修道院的魯萊神父能幫你！

10037.en: We serve the way of the Holy Work!

10038.en: Those who walk the holy path know the way!

10047.en: The Hidden Temple of Munkharama, underworld of the fallen brothers!
10047.zh: 僧侶聖地隱密神殿，墮落修士的地下世界！

10048.en: It lies beneath the Holy City of Munkharama...
10048.zh: 它就在聖城僧侶聖地底下……

10056.en: I heard he makes very bad tea!

10058.en: He attends the Apothecary in Munkharama...
10058.zh: 他在僧侶聖地的藥鋪做事……

10061.en: Master Xheng, Lord of the 5 Flowers...

10063.en: He is master of a secret school in Munkharama...
10063.zh: 他是僧侶聖地一所秘密學院的院主……

10071.en: Father Rulae teaches how to walk the holy path!
10071.zh: 魯萊神父教導如何行走聖道！

10073.en: He spends his days at Thesminster Abbey, in New City...
10073.zh: 他終日待在新城的希斯敏斯特修道院……

10076.en: The diseased Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
10076.zh: 染病的丹恩家族之主，聖工的褻瀆者！

10078.en: Tis said he practices unholy rituals atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
10078.zh: 據說他在狄奧尼修斯之塔頂舉行邪穢儀式……

10086.en: The blasphemous scorn of Dane, may their souls burn forever!
10086.zh: 丹恩那群瀆神之徒，願他們的靈魂永遠燃燒！

10088.en: They spread their wickedness from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
10088.zh: 他們從邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

10091.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
10091.zh: 當心基馬斯·圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

10093.en: Kymas Turan flings his iniquitous filth upon all who come near...
10093.zh: 基馬斯·圖蘭將邪穢污物潑向所有靠近者……

10097.en: Dionysceus, the Unholy Tower, and House of the blaspheming Danes!
10097.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，邪穢之塔，瀆神丹恩眾之家！

10098.en: Beware, only the wicked walk through the unholy lands of Dane!
10098.zh: 當心，只有惡徒才會走過丹恩的邪穢之地！

10106.en: The prophecy shall purge the unholy, and leads us to salvation!
10106.zh: 預言將滌淨邪穢，引領我們走向救贖！

10111.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
10111.zh: 想行走夢土，就尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

10202.en: I make flying sticks, sharp and pointy!

10212.en: Me like shiney coins, you bring me plenty!
10212.zh: 我愛亮晶晶錢幣，你多帶來！

10213.en: No no no! &Shiney coins be mine!
10213.zh: 不行不行！&亮晶晶錢幣我的！

10217.en: Me have fine shooters! &You buy some!

10219.en: Me get you what you want, you give me coins!
10219.zh: 你要什麼我拿來，你給錢幣！

10222.en: Me make best flying sticks with special juice!
10222.zh: 我用特製藥水做最棒飛棍！

10224.en: Me get you what you want, you give me coins!
10224.zh: 你要什麼我拿來，你給錢幣！

10232.en: Magic wing fur make sticks fly!

10233.en: Me have magic juice for making sticks fly!
10233.zh: 我有讓飛棍飛的魔法藥水！

10234.en: Me get magic wing fur, you give me coins!
10234.zh: 我拿魔法翼毛，你給錢幣！

10242.en: Me have special magic juice for making wing fur fly!
10242.zh: 我有讓翼毛飛的特製魔法藥水！

10243.en: You give me coins, I give what you need!

10251.en: The Razuka are fattest, lords of all Rattkin!
10251.zh: 拉祖卡最肥，是所有鼠人的王！

10252.en: Razuka big fat, keep many coins, has treasure plenty!
10252.zh: 拉祖卡肥肥，錢多多，寶藏滿滿！

10253.en: Razuka keeps treasure hidden, you no tell Razuka!
10253.zh: 拉祖卡偷偷藏寶，你不准告訴拉祖卡！

10254.en: Razuka has secret place, me no tell you!
10254.zh: 拉祖卡有秘密地方，我不告訴你！

10257.en: Many many shiney coins, much more than Bertie!
10257.zh: 好多好多亮晶晶錢幣，比貝提多好多！

10258.en: Razuka keeps treasure hidden, you no tell Razuka!
10258.zh: 拉祖卡偷偷藏寶，你不准告訴拉祖卡！

10259.en: Razuka has secret place, me no tell you!
10259.zh: 拉祖卡有秘密地方，我不告訴你！

10261.en: Don Barlone' is head of the family of Razuka!
10261.zh: 唐·巴隆內是拉祖卡家族的首領！

10266.en: Ratsputin, the gathering paw of the Razuka!
10266.zh: 鼠拉斯普丁，拉祖卡的召集之爪！

10268.en: He's making the rounds, I'm sure!

10273.en: I'm sure you find him sooner or later!

10276.en: He's one of my best customers!
10276.zh: 他是我最好的主顧之一！

10278.en: He comes in to shop here often!

10282.en: Our home here in the forest...

10283.en: In the woods, down the valley, through the vale, over the mountains!
10283.zh: 在林間，沿山谷而下，穿過溪谷，翻越群山！

10286.en: The old Funhouse, perhaps best to stay away from there...
10286.zh: 老玩笑屋，最好別靠近那裡……

10291.en: Ratskell's has many unusual items for the fleet of hand!
10291.zh: 拉茨凱爾店裡有許多稀奇貨品，供巧手之人選購！

10293.en: Ratskell's shoppe, around and over, through and up, can't miss it!
10293.zh: 拉茨凱爾的店，繞過再翻過，穿過再往上，絕不會錯過！

10297.en: Old Blindmeis might be able to help you!
10297.zh: 老盲麥斯也許能幫上你的忙！

10302.en: Masters of the trade belong to the Guild...
10302.zh: 這一行的頂尖好手都屬於公會……

10402.en: I am but a humble brother in the Fellowship of Dane!
10402.zh: 我只是丹恩團契裡一名卑微的修士！

10403.en: I am here, in the House of Dane!
10403.zh: 我人在這裡，在丹恩家裡！

10422.en: The Jonga spice is a special blessing, use it well!
10422.zh: 榮加香料是特別的祝福，要好好使用！

10423.en: Pour it into the sacramental urns as a show of thy good faith!
10423.zh: 把它倒進聖甕，以示汝之誠心！

10431.en: The Magna Dane, ruler of the House of Dane!

10433.en: The Magna Dane rules from atop the Great Tower of Dane!
10433.zh: 大丹恩從丹恩大塔的塔頂統治！

10441.en: The great Kymas Turan, the Deliverer, spreads the word of Dane!
10441.zh: 偉大的基馬斯·圖蘭，救世者，宣揚丹恩之道！

10446.en: Speak kindly of the brother that helps all arise in the House of Dane!
10446.zh: 好好稱許那位幫助眾人在丹恩家晉升的修士！

10448.en: He travels the sacred halls of the Tower of Dane!
10448.zh: 他行走於丹恩大塔的聖堂！

10451.en: Brother Belcanzor helps those in need of special assistance...
10451.zh: 貝爾坎佐修士幫助需要特殊協助的人……

10453.en: The good brother Belcanzor is here and there, as he pleases...
10453.zh: 善良的貝爾坎佐修士隨心所至，四處雲遊……

10456.en: Dionysceus, the Great Tower, the House of Dane!
10456.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，巨塔，丹恩家！

10458.en: Dionysceus, the Great Tower which shadows the Myrmideon Forest...
10458.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，籠罩蜜爾米頓森林的巨塔……

10467.en: The holy House of Dane, the Great Tower of the Righteous!
10467.zh: 神聖的丹恩家，義者的巨塔！

10468.en: The House of Dane, the Great Tower of Dionysceus!
10468.zh: 丹恩家，狄奧尼修斯巨塔！

10471.en: Only the most deserved may hope to join the ranks of the High Fathers!
10471.zh: 唯有最夠資格者，方能冀望晉升高階神父之列！

10473.en: The High Fathers sit by the throne of the holy Magna Dane!
10473.zh: 高階神父們坐在神聖大丹恩的王座之旁！

10477.en: Those rising high in the House of Dane shall know great power!
10477.zh: 在丹恩家高升者，將知曉強大的力量！

10481.en: Speak not that sinful name, lest thee summon the Magna Dane!
10481.zh: 別提那罪惡之名，免得召來大丹恩！

10486.en: We seek to still the tongue of that drunken evil cur!
10486.zh: 我們要讓那醉鬼惡犬閉上嘴！

10491.en: Father Rulae, the unfortunate fool of the blaspheming Munk!
10491.zh: 魯萊神父，瀆神穆克的可憐蠢貨！

10493.en: They say he spreads the lies of Munk in the heart of New City...
10493.zh: 據說他在新城中心散播穆克的謊言……

10497.en: Let not the righteous set foot within that place of evil!
10497.zh: 義者切勿踏進那邪惡之地！

10502.en: By prophecy the world shall end and shallow the unrighteous!
10502.zh: 依預言，世界將終結，不義者將遭吞沒！

10507.en: Repent, O ye sinners! &Repent thy evil and wicked ways before the end!
10507.zh: 懺悔吧，罪人們！&在終末前懺悔你邪惡的行徑！

10511.en: May the divine light guide thee!

10516.en: May a thousand diseases plague the lands of Munk!
10516.zh: 願千般疫病降罰穆克之地！

10522.en: The sacramental urns, holy vessels for thy humble offerings...
10522.zh: 聖甕，供奉你謙卑奉獻的神聖器皿……

10523.en: The sacramental urns lie throughout the Great Tower of Dane...
10523.zh: 聖甕散布在丹恩大塔各處……

10601.en: I am Ke-Li, Dame Queen of the Helazoid!
10601.zh: 我是柯麗，赫詹族的女王陛下！

10603.en: I am the Defender of the City of Sky, Higardia!
10603.zh: 我是天空之城希加爾迪亞的守護者！

10617.en: Higardia, City of Sky, home of the Helazoid, Defenders of the Higardi!
10617.zh: 希加爾迪亞，天空之城，赫詹族的家園，希加爾迪的守護者！

10618.en: High atop the Dragon Mountains lies the City of Sky!
10618.zh: 天空之城高踞龍之山脈之巔！

10628.en: He rules the heavens on high!

10666.en: By his name, surely you be the heralds of the prophecy!
10666.zh: 以他之名，你們必是預言的先驅！

10674.en: The Hall of Preservation lies here, in the City of Sky!
10674.zh: 保存殿就在這裡，在天空之城！

10691.en: Only the fates may decide upon the Crusaders!
10691.zh: 唯命運諸神能裁決十字軍！

10696.en: Jan-Ette has been sent to the northlands, in search of the Crusaders!
10696.zh: 珍妮特已被派往北方國度，尋找十字軍！

10701.en: Only we of the Helazoid Legion may ride upon the flying steeds...
10701.zh: 只有我們赫詹軍團能乘飛天坐騎……

10703.en: We have many flying machines in the City of Sky!
10703.zh: 我們在天空之城有許多飛行機器！

10711.en: In the City of Sky there are many machines...
10711.zh: 天空之城裡有許多機器……

10716.en: Let me see this banner that you speak of...
10716.zh: 讓我看看你所說的旗幟……

10802.en: I live here, by the sea...

10847.en: If you're thinking of swimmming in the sea, you'd better think again!
10847.zh: 要是你打算在海裡游泳，最好再想想！

10856.en: Those are just a few little tadpoles from the deep sea!
10856.zh: 那些只是來自深海的幾隻小蝌蚪！

10901.en: I am Master Xen Xheng, teacher of the school of 5 Flowers...
10901.zh: 我是鄭大師，五花門的導師……

10912.en: Only the worthy may learn the secrets of the 5 Flowers...
10912.zh: 唯有夠資格者能學五花的奧秘……

10916.en: Father Rulae teaches how to walk the holy path!
10916.zh: 魯萊神父教導如何行走聖道！

10918.en: He spends his days at Thesminster Abbey, in New City...
10918.zh: 他終日待在新城的希斯敏斯特修道院……

10921.en: I heard he makes very bad tea!

10923.en: He attends the Apothecary in Munkharama...
10923.zh: 他在僧侶聖地的藥鋪做事……

10927.en: Those that walk the holy path shall know the way!

10932.en: We walk the path of the Holy Work, teachings of the divine Munkharam!
10932.zh: 我們行走聖工之路，遵循神聖穆克哈拉姆的教誨！

10933.en: Those who walk the holy path live the Holy Work!

10941.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
10941.zh: 想行走夢土，就尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

10952.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, the city of the Holy Work...
10952.zh: 僧侶聖地這座聖城，正是聖工之城……

10953.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
10953.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地位於艾恩河以東……

10956.en: The divine prophet of all Munk, the holy Munkharam!
10956.zh: 全體穆克的神聖先知，神聖的穆克哈拉姆！

10958.en: The divine Munkharam leads all who walk the holy path...
10958.zh: 神聖的穆克哈拉姆引領所有行走聖道的人……

10961.en: The insane Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
10961.zh: 丹恩家病態的主子，聖工的褻瀆者！

10963.en: He performs unholy rituals high atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
10963.zh: 他從狄奧尼修斯塔頂施行邪穢的儀式……

10971.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
10971.zh: 當心基馬斯·圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

10973.en: Kymas Turan flings his iniquitous filth upon all who come near...
10973.zh: 基馬斯·圖蘭將邪穢污物潑向所有靠近者……

10976.en: The misguided Brothers of Dane, may we purge the lands of their evil!
10976.zh: 丹恩家那群誤入歧途的修士，願我們肅清其邪惡！

10978.en: They spread their evil words from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
10978.zh: 他們從邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

10982.en: Dionysceus, the Unholy Tower, and House of the zealot Danes!
10982.zh: 狄奧尼修斯、邪穢之塔，以及狂熱丹恩的殿堂！

10983.en: Beware, only the evil walk through the unholy lands of Dane!
10983.zh: 當心，唯有邪惡之徒能行走於丹恩的邪穢之地！

10991.en: The prophecy shall cleanse the evil from our lands!
10991.zh: 預言將洗淨我們土地上的邪惡！

11012.en: The life of the unfortunate is not easy...
11012.zh: 不幸之人的人生不好過……

11013.en: Such a secret is worth keeping!

11017.en: What you need are some special charms!
11017.zh: 你需要一些特殊的護符！

11018.en: Perhaps you should shoppe at Ratskell's!
11018.zh: 也許你該去拉茨凱爾店逛逛！

11026.en: Ratskell's has many unusual items to help supplement your skills...
11026.zh: 拉茨凱爾店有許多珍奇貨品，可輔助你的技能……

11037.en: I'd prefer not to talk about it...

11046.en: The Razuka, bosses of the underworld!
11046.zh: 拉祖卡，地下世界的老大們！

11048.en: It's rumored that the Razuka hole up in the old Funhouse...
11048.zh: 謠傳拉祖卡窩藏在老玩笑屋裡……

11061.en: Don Barlone', ruthless head of the Razuka!
11061.zh: 唐·巴隆內，拉祖卡冷酷的首腦！

11063.en: It's rumored that the Razuka hole up in the old Funhouse...
11063.zh: 謠傳拉祖卡窩藏在老玩笑屋裡……

11067.en: Masters of the trade belong to the Guild...
11067.zh: 這一行的頂尖好手都屬於公會……

11072.en: Ratskell's, the guild of all thieves!
11072.zh: 拉茨凱爾店，眾盜賊的公會！

11086.en: He died long ago, I know nothing else...
11086.zh: 他很久以前就死了，其他我一無所知……

11091.en: Ratsputin, the gathering paw of the Razuka!
11091.zh: 鼠拉斯普丁，拉祖卡的召集之爪！

11093.en: He's making the rounds, I'm sure!

11096.en: Mick the Pick, fleetest of them all!
11096.zh: 撬鎖米克，身手最矯捷的一個！

11101.en: Bertie has lots of sharp goodies for sale...
11101.zh: 貝提有好多鋒利的好貨要賣……

11103.en: Bertie's shoppe, around and over, through and up, can't miss it!
11103.zh: 貝提的店，繞過去再上去，穿過去爬上來，不會錯過的！

11107.en: Our home here in the forest...

11108.en: In the woods, down the valley, through the vale, over the mountains!
11108.zh: 在林間，沿山谷而下，穿過溪谷，翻越群山！

11201.en: I'm Sergeant Kabomm, head of the Supply Depot...
11201.zh: 我是卡邦姆中士，補給庫的主管……

11203.en: If you need gear or ammo, you'll find me here at the Supply Depot...
11203.zh: 需要裝備或彈藥，就到補給庫來找我……

11212.en: The Supply Depot is where all I.U.F.'s requisition gear and ammo...
11212.zh: 補給庫是 I.U.F. 將士請領裝備彈藥的地方……

11213.en: If you need some additional supplies, just let me know...
11213.zh: 需要額外的補給品就告訴我……

11217.en: I've got all kinds of gear for the well-equipped soldier!
11217.zh: 各種裝備應有盡有，讓士兵武裝齊全！

11218.en: Take a look at what I've got and let me know if you want something...
11218.zh: 看看我的貨，想要什麼就說一聲……

11219.en: The only supplies I have are kept here at the Depot...
11219.zh: 我僅有的補給品都存放在補給庫……

11231.en: If you want to learn to shoot, go practice at the Firing Range...
11231.zh: 想學射擊，就去射擊場練習……

11242.en: You need to put in your target practice at the Firing Range...
11242.zh: 你得去射擊場好好練打靶……

11243.en: See Lieutenant Gromo, he'll set you up with targets...
11243.zh: 找格羅莫中尉，他會幫你安排靶子……

11244.en: It's across from the North Barracks, just over that-a-way...
11244.zh: 就在北營房對面，往那邊走就是……

11246.en: He's at the Firing Range... &Now either buy something or scram...
11246.zh: 他在射擊場……&要買就買，不然就滾……

11251.en: I hear our forces are tracking a band of spies in our midst!
11251.zh: 聽說我軍正在追查混進我們之中的間諜！

11256.en: General Yamo, Commander of the I.U.F., Imperial Umpani Forces!
11256.zh: 亞莫將軍，恩帕尼帝國軍 I.U.F. 的統帥！

11258.en: His office is over at the I.U.F. Command Headquarters...
11258.zh: 他的辦公室在 I.U.F. 指揮總部……

11261.en: Rodan Lewarx, Master Tracker under the command of General Yamo...
11261.zh: 羅丹·勒瓦克斯，亞莫將軍麾下的追蹤大師……

11263.en: Laying a trap for the wretched T'Rang insects, I hope!
11263.zh: 希望是在給卑劣的特蘭格蟲子設陷阱！

11266.en: Tracker Rhallick is a scout for the I.U.F...
11266.zh: 追蹤者拉利克是 I.U.F. 的斥候……

11268.en: Laying a trap for the wretched T'Rang insects, I hope!
11268.zh: 希望是在給卑劣的特蘭格蟲子設陷阱！

11271.en: Lt. Gruntwrapper is under special orders from General Yamo...
11271.zh: 格蘭特拉普中尉奉亞莫將軍的特別命令行事……

11273.en: I haven't seen him around lately...

11276.en: Rossarian is a swarthy trader, who came here for his own reasons...
11276.zh: 羅薩里安是個膚色黝黑的商人，為自己的目的來到此地……

11278.en: I've heard he's been seen around New City...
11278.zh: 聽說有人在新城一帶看過他……

11281.en: Sgt. Balbrak is the Recruiting Officer, in charge of enlistments...
11281.zh: 巴布拉克中士是募兵官，負責招募入伍……

11283.en: Why don't you try looking for him down at the Recruiting Station...
11283.zh: 何不去募兵站那裡找找他……

11287.en: I.U.F., that stands for Imperial Umpani Forces!
11287.zh: I.U.F.，就是恩帕尼帝國軍的縮寫！

11288.en: The I.U.F. is always looking for a few good snouts!
11288.zh: I.U.F. 永遠在找幾個好鼻子！

11297.en: Ukpyr is our temporary Command Headquarters on this planet...
11297.zh: 烏克皮爾是我們在這顆行星上的臨時指揮總部……

11298.en: Ukpyr is just this side of the Ukpyr Mountains...
11298.zh: 烏克皮爾就在烏克皮爾山脈的這一側……

11306.en: I've heard there's a Black Market operating in New City somewhere...
11306.zh: 聽說新城某處有個黑市在營業……

11311.en: Death to the T'Rang vermin, destroyer of worlds!
11311.zh: 特蘭格害蟲，世界的毀滅者，去死吧！

11313.en: Everywhere, but one day we shall rid the universe of their kind!
11313.zh: 無所不在，但總有一天我們會把他們從宇宙清除！

11402.en: I am master of T'Rang assassins...
11402.zh: 我是特蘭格刺客的首領……

11403.en: My plans are not for you to know...

11411.en: The great H'Jenn-Ra, Lord of T'Rang, is very wise...
11411.zh: 偉大的赫詹拉，特蘭格之主，非常有智慧……

11413.en: H'Jenn-Ra is safely guarded in the northern lands...
11413.zh: 赫詹拉在北方之地受到嚴密保護……

11416.en: K'Borra T'Rang is the cunning lacky of H'Jenn-Ra...
11416.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格是赫詹拉狡詐的走狗……

11421.en: D'Rang T'Rang is the reckless young nephew of K'Borra T'Rang...
11421.zh: 德蘭·特蘭格是克波拉·特蘭格魯莽的年輕姪子……

11427.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11427.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11432.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11432.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11437.en: The northern ruins of Nyctalinth serves as our temporary base...
11437.zh: 北方的夜螢城遺跡是我們的臨時基地……

11438.en: Nyctalinth lies north of the Red Forest...
11438.zh: 夜螢城位於赤色森林以北……

11441.en: General Yamo is the fat-bellied commander of the Umpani toads!
11441.zh: 亞莫將軍是恩帕尼蟾蜍的大肚皮指揮官！

11443.en: He cowers in the jungles of the east, in the Ukpyr Mountains...
11443.zh: 他龜縮在東方的叢林裡，烏克皮爾山脈之中……

11451.en: Do not mention this name again...

11456.en: If you know of the legendary globe, tell me more...
11456.zh: 若你知道那顆傳說中的球體，請多告訴我……

11461.en: Hssst-Heh heh... &It gave me great pleasure to watch him suffer!
11461.zh: 嘶嘶——嘿嘿……&看著他受苦，真讓我心花怒放！

11501.en: I am K'Borra T'Rang, mighty claw of the great H'Jenn-Ra...
11501.zh: 我是克波拉·特蘭格，偉大赫詹拉的強悍之爪……

11503.en: My plans are not for you to know...

11511.en: K'Borra T'Rang does not presume to speak for the great H'Jenn-Ra...
11511.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格豈敢代偉大的赫詹拉發言……

11513.en: H'Jenn-Ra commands from our outpost in the northern lands...
11513.zh: 赫詹拉在北方之地的前哨坐鎮指揮……

11516.en: The mighty Shritis T'Rang, leader of assasins!
11516.zh: 強大的希里提斯·特蘭格，刺客之首！

11517.en: The great T'Rang assassin leads a special mission for the Empire...
11517.zh: 偉大的特蘭格刺客正為帝國執行一項特殊任務……

11518.zh: 希里提斯行事，只憑自己高興……

11521.en: D'Rang T'Rang is my strong and clever young nephew...
11521.zh: 德蘭·特蘭格是我強壯又機靈的年輕姪子……

11523.en: D'Rang is no doubt sending the Umpani toads fleeing, even as we speak!
11523.zh: 此時此刻，德蘭肯定正把恩帕尼蟾蜍殺得落荒而逃！

11527.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11527.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11532.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11532.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11537.en: The northern ruins of Nyctalinth serves as our temporary base...
11537.zh: 北方的夜螢城遺跡是我們的臨時基地……

11538.en: Nyctalinth lies north of the Red Forest...
11538.zh: 夜螢城位於赤色森林以北……

11541.en: General Yamo is the fat-bellied commander of the Umpani toads!
11541.zh: 亞莫將軍是恩帕尼蟾蜍的大肚皮指揮官！

11543.en: He cowers in the jungles of the east, in the Ukpyr Mountains...
11543.zh: 他龜縮在東方的叢林裡，烏克皮爾山脈之中……

11546.en: Rodan Lewarx is the master tracker for the blubbering Umpani cows!
11546.zh: 羅丹·勒瓦克斯是那些哭嚎恩帕尼母牛的追蹤大師！

11548.en: If I could find him, I would destroy him!
11548.zh: 只要能找到他，我必毀了他！

11551.en: Do not mention this name again...

11556.en: If you know of the legendary globe, tell me more...
11556.zh: 若你知道那顆傳說中的球體，請多告訴我……

11561.en: I do not know of what you speak... &Let us not talk of this further...
11561.zh: 我不知道你在說什麼……&這件事就別再說了……

11601.en: I am D'Rang T'Rang, important leader in the T'Rang Empire...
11601.zh: 我是德蘭·特蘭格，特蘭格帝國舉足輕重的領袖……

11603.en: I seek out the whimpering Umpani hogs, to destroy them!
11603.zh: 我專門追獵那些哀嚎的恩帕尼肥豬，消滅他們！

11611.en: The great H'Jenn-Ra, Lord of T'Rang, is very wise...
11611.zh: 偉大的赫詹拉，特蘭格之主，非常有智慧……

11613.en: H'Jenn-Ra is safely guarded in the northern lands...
11613.zh: 赫詹拉在北方之地受到嚴密保護……

11616.en: The mighty Shritis T'Rang, leader of assassins!
11616.zh: 強大的希里提斯·特蘭格，刺客之首！

11617.en: The great T'Rang assassin leads a special mission for the Empire...
11617.zh: 偉大的特蘭格刺客正為帝國執行一項特殊任務……

11618.zh: 希里提斯行事，只憑自己高興……

11621.en: K'Borra T'Rang is my uncle, second only to the great H'Jenn-Ra...
11621.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格是我的叔叔，地位僅次於偉大的赫詹拉……

11623.en: K'Borra T'Rang is laying a trap for the blundering Umpani cows!
11623.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格正在給莽撞的恩帕尼母牛設下陷阱！

11627.en: That is our space shuttle... &Hssst! How do you know of this?
11627.zh: 那是我們的太空梭……&嘶嘶！你怎麼會知道這件事？

11632.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11632.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11637.en: The northern ruins of Nyctalinth serves as our temporary base...
11637.zh: 北方的夜螢城遺跡是我們的臨時基地……

11638.en: Nyctalinth lies north of the Red Forest...
11638.zh: 夜螢城位於赤色森林以北……

11641.en: General Yamo is the fat-bellied commander of the Umpani toads!
11641.zh: 亞莫將軍是恩帕尼蟾蜍的大肚皮指揮官！

11643.en: He cowers in the jungles of the east, in the Ukpyr Mountains...
11643.zh: 他龜縮在東方的叢林裡，烏克皮爾山脈之中……

11646.en: Rodan Lewarx is the master tracker for the blubbering Umpani cows!
11646.zh: 羅丹·勒瓦克斯是那些哭嚎恩帕尼母牛的追蹤大師！

11648.en: If I could find him, I would destroy him!
11648.zh: 只要能找到他，我必毀了他！

11651.en: I am not afraid of this Dark Savant, let him show his face to D'Rang!
11651.zh: 我才不怕什麼黑暗賢者，叫他來向德蘭露臉吧！

11653.en: I have not seen him... &They say he rides upon his black ship...
11653.zh: 我沒見過他……&據說他乘著他的黑船……

11656.en: If you know of the legendary globe, tell me more...
11656.zh: 若你知道那顆傳說中的球體，請多告訴我……

11662.en: The Black Ship, vessel of the Dark Savant, known as the Dedaelis...
11662.zh: 黑船，黑暗賢者的座艦，人稱迪達利斯……

11663.en: Up there somewhere, I am told...

11701.en: I am Rodan Lewarx, son of Hector, Master of all Umpani Trackers...
11701.zh: 我是羅丹·勒瓦克斯，赫克特之子，恩帕尼全體追蹤者的大師……

11702.en: I seek the head of Shritis T'Rang, vengeance shall be mine!!
11702.zh: 我要取希里提斯·特蘭格的項上人頭，血債必償！！

11712.en: He is dead by the claw of an assassin, the claw of Shritis T'Rang!
11712.zh: 他死於刺客之爪——希里提斯·特蘭格的爪下！

11716.en: General Yamo is the current Commander-In-Chief of the I.U.F....
11716.zh: 亞莫將軍是 I.U.F. 現任的最高統帥……

11718.en: Command headquarters, at the base in Ukpyr...
11718.zh: 指揮總部，就在烏克皮爾的基地……

11721.en: Tracker Rhallick is a scout for the I.U.F...
11721.zh: 追蹤者拉利克是 I.U.F. 的斥候……

11723.en: Laying a trap for the wretched T'Rang insects, I hope!
11723.zh: 希望是在給卑劣的特蘭格蟲子設陷阱！

11726.en: Lt. Gruntwrapper is under special orders from General Yamo...
11726.zh: 格蘭特拉普中尉奉亞莫將軍的特別命令行事……

11731.en: Rossarian is a swarthy trader, who came here for his own reasons...
11731.zh: 羅薩里安是個膚色黝黑的商人，為自己的目的來到此地……

11733.en: Rumors have it that he is running a Black Market out of New City...
11733.zh: 謠傳他在新城經營著一處黑市……

11736.en: He's an officer in the I.U.F...
11736.zh: 他是恩帕尼帝國軍的軍官……

11738.en: He was at our base in Ukpyr, the last time I saw him...
11738.zh: 上次見到他時，他就在我們烏克皮爾的基地……

11752.en: I.U.F., that stands for Imperial Umpani Forces!
11752.zh: I.U.F.，就是恩帕尼帝國軍的縮寫！

11753.en: The I.U.F. Command Headquarters is at our base in Ukpyr...
11753.zh: 恩帕尼帝國軍指揮總部就在我們烏克皮爾的基地……

11762.en: Ukpyr is the location of our Command Headquarters...
11762.zh: 烏克皮爾是我們指揮總部的所在地……

11763.en: Ukpyr is east through the jungles, this side of the Ukpyr Mountains...
11763.zh: 穿過叢林往東就是烏克皮爾，在烏克皮爾山脈這一側……

11772.en: If you don't know, I can't help you...
11772.zh: 你不知道的話，我幫不上忙……

11773.en: Travel to our base in Ukpyr, they can direct you from there...
11773.zh: 去我們烏克皮爾的基地，那裡的人能為你指路……

11786.en: I've heard there's a Black Market operating in New City somewhere...
11786.zh: 聽說新城某處有個黑市在營業……

11791.en: I shall not rest until all T'Rang are eliminated!
11791.zh: 不把特蘭格斬草除根，我絕不罷休！

11793.en: Everywhere, but one day we shall rid the universe of their kind!
11793.zh: 無所不在，但總有一天我們會把他們從宇宙清除！

11796.en: H'Jenn-Ra is the diseased head of the T'Rang...

12301.en: I am King Ulgar, ruler of the Gorn Empire!
12301.zh: 我是烏爾加王，高恩帝國的統治者！

12302.en: I seek to save our Empire from the tragedy of Civil War!
12302.zh: 我要拯救帝國，使其免於內戰的悲劇！

12303.en: I shall travel the lands, and weave my own plans!
12303.zh: 我將行走各地，編織我自己的計畫！

12311.en: Lord Galiere, the regal vassal, loyal to my throne!
12311.zh: 加列爾勳爵，尊貴的封臣，忠於我的王座！

12312.en: He gives his sword to preserve the kingdom of Gorn!
12312.zh: 他獻出劍來守護高恩王國！

12314.en: He is attempting to thwart the Civil War that plagues the land of Gorn!
12314.zh: 他正設法阻止蹂躪高恩大地的內戰！

12316.en: He disappeared not long ago, and we fear for the worst!
12316.zh: 他不久前失蹤了，我們擔心最壞的情況！

12321.en: Alas, poor wizard Murkatos, the betrayer betrayed!
12321.zh: 唉，可憐的法師穆卡托斯，叛徒反遭背叛！

12322.en: Poor Murkatos, once the great Wizard of Gorn, now a pile of bones...
12322.zh: 可憐的穆卡托斯，昔日高恩的偉大法師，如今只剩一堆白骨……

12331.en: Orkogre Castle, now lying steeped in the blood of Gorn!
12331.zh: 奧高高城堡，如今浸在高恩的血泊之中！

12341.en: Damn the prophecies, I will have my kingdom restored!
12341.zh: 去他的預言，我一定要重掌王國！

12347.en: Civil War now ravages our land and army, the fall of the Gorn Empire!
12347.zh: 內戰正肆虐我國的國土與軍隊，高恩帝國就要傾覆了！

12348.en: The Civil War that tears our lands, and rips the kingdom apart!
12348.zh: 這場內戰撕裂我們的國土，把王國扯得四分五裂！

12351.en: T'would destory the plan, should I let it pass my lips!

12552.zh: 眾人皆受騙，如今皆受苦！

12601.en: I am Master Xheng, Lord of the 5 Flowers...
12601.zh: 我是鄭大師，五花門之主……

12602.zh: 我傳授五花門，以及聖工之道……

12603.en: I walk the lands to teach the way of the Holy Work!
12603.zh: 我行走各地，傳授聖工之道！

12611.zh: 喬伯修士守衛通往僧侶聖地的橋……

12616.zh: 魯萊神父引領欲行聖道之人！

12618.en: He spends his days at Thesminster Abbey, in New City...
12618.zh: 他終日待在新城的希斯敏斯特修道院……

12621.en: I heard he makes very bad tea!

12623.en: He attends the Apothecary in Munkharama...
12623.zh: 他在僧侶聖地的藥鋪做事……

12626.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
12626.zh: 想行走夢土，就尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

12637.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, the city of the Holy Work...
12637.zh: 僧侶聖地這座聖城，正是聖工之城……

12638.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
12638.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地位於艾恩河以東……

12641.en: All good brothers walk the holy path!
12641.zh: 所有良善修士皆行聖道！

12642.en: Those who would live the Holy Work, walk the holy path!
12642.zh: 想踐行聖工的人，要走聖道！

12643.en: Father Rulae of Thesminster Abbey shows the way of the holy path...
12643.zh: 希斯敏斯特修道院的魯萊神父會指引聖道……

12647.en: We walk the path of the Holy Work, teachings of the divine Munkharam!
12647.zh: 我們行走聖工之路，遵循神聖穆克哈拉姆的教誨！

12648.en: Those who walk the holy path live the Holy Work!

12656.en: The divine prophet of all Munk, the holy Munkharam!
12656.zh: 全體穆克的神聖先知，神聖的穆克哈拉姆！

12658.en: The divine Munkharam leads all who walk the holy path...
12658.zh: 神聖的穆克哈拉姆引領所有行走聖道的人……

12661.en: The misguided Brothers of Dane, may we purge the lands of their filth!
12661.zh: 誤入歧途的丹恩弟兄，願我們淨化其污穢！

12663.en: They spread their wickedness from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
12663.zh: 他們從邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

12666.en: The diseased Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
12666.zh: 染病的丹恩家族之主，聖工的褻瀆者！

12668.en: He practices his unholy rituals from atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
12668.zh: 他在狄奧尼修斯之塔頂舉行邪穢儀式……

12676.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
12676.zh: 當心基馬斯·圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

12678.en: Kymas Turan flings his iniquitous filth upon all who come near...
12678.zh: 基馬斯·圖蘭將邪穢污物潑向所有靠近者……

12682.en: Dionysceus, the Unholy Tower, and House of the blaspheming Danes!
12682.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，邪穢之塔，瀆神丹恩眾之家！

12683.en: Beware, only the wicked walk through the unholy lands of Dane!
12683.zh: 當心，只有惡徒才會走過丹恩的邪穢之地！

12686.en: The prophecy shall cleanse the evil from our lands!
12686.zh: 預言將洗淨我們土地上的邪惡！

12801.en: I am Brother TShober, guardian of the Bridge to Munkharama...
12801.zh: 我是喬伯修士，通往僧侶聖地之橋的守護者……

12802.en: I shall trounce the heads of the unholy blasphemous Dane!
12802.zh: 我要痛毆邪穢瀆神的丹恩之輩！

12811.en: Master Xheng, Lord of the 5 Flowers...

12812.en: Master Xheng keeps safe the Holy Work, and walks the rightful path...
12812.zh: 鄭大師守護聖工，並行走正道……

12813.en: He is master of a secret school in Munkharama...
12813.zh: 他是僧侶聖地一所秘密學院的院主……

12816.en: Father Rulae teaches how to walk the holy path!
12816.zh: 魯萊神父教導如何行走聖道！

12818.en: He spends his days at Thesminster Abbey, in New City...
12818.zh: 他終日待在新城的希斯敏斯特修道院……

12821.en: I heard he makes very bad tea!

12823.en: He attends the Apothecary in Munkharama...
12823.zh: 他在僧侶聖地的藥鋪做事……

12826.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
12826.zh: 想行走夢土，就尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

12837.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, the city of the Holy Work...
12837.zh: 僧侶聖地這座聖城，正是聖工之城……

12838.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
12838.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地位於艾恩河以東……

12841.en: All good brothers walk the holy path!
12841.zh: 所有良善修士皆行聖道！

12842.en: Those who would live the Holy Work, walk the holy path!
12842.zh: 想踐行聖工的人，要走聖道！

12843.en: Father Rulae of Thesminster Abbey shows the way of the holy path...
12843.zh: 希斯敏斯特修道院的魯萊神父會指引聖道……

12856.en: The divine prophet of all Munk, the holy Munkharam!
12856.zh: 全體穆克的神聖先知，神聖的穆克哈拉姆！

12858.en: The divine Munkharam leads all who walk the holy path...
12858.zh: 神聖的穆克哈拉姆引領所有行走聖道的人……

12861.en: The blasphemous scorn of Dane, may their souls burn forever!
12861.zh: 丹恩那群瀆神之徒，願他們的靈魂永遠燃燒！

12863.en: They spread their wickedness from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
12863.zh: 他們從邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

12866.en: The diseased Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
12866.zh: 染病的丹恩家族之主，聖工的褻瀆者！

12868.en: Tis said he practices unholy rituals atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
12868.zh: 據說他在狄奧尼修斯之塔頂舉行邪穢儀式……

12876.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
12876.zh: 當心基馬斯·圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

12878.en: Kymas Turan flings his iniquitous filth upon all who come near...
12878.zh: 基馬斯·圖蘭將邪穢污物潑向所有靠近者……

12882.en: Dionysceus, the Unholy Tower, and House of the blaspheming Danes!
12882.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，邪穢之塔，瀆神丹恩眾之家！

12883.en: Beware, only the wicked walk through the unholy lands of Dane!
12883.zh: 當心，只有惡徒才會走過丹恩的邪穢之地！

12886.en: The prophecy shall purge the unholy, and leads us to salvation!
12886.zh: 預言將滌淨邪穢，引領我們走向救贖！

12901.zh: 我叫鼠拉斯普丁，我執行拉祖卡的意志！

12911.en: Don Barlone' is head of the family...

12913.en: That is not for me to say...

12916.en: Mick the Pick, fleetest of them all!
12916.zh: 撬鎖米克，身手最矯捷的一個！

12923.en: I'm sure you'll bump into him sooner or later...

12927.en: Our forest home in the northern lands...
12927.zh: 我們在北方的森林家園……

12936.zh: 老玩笑屋，最好別靠近那裡……

12941.zh: 拉茨凱爾店裡有許多稀奇貨品，供巧手之人選購！

12943.en: Ratskell's shoppe is in our forest home...
12943.zh: 拉茨凱爾的店就在我們的森林家園……

12947.en: Old Blindmeis might be able to help you, heh heh...
12947.zh: 老盲麥斯或許能幫上你的忙，嘿嘿……

12951.en: The Razuka, the mighty paw of the land!
12951.zh: 拉祖卡，這片土地的威猛之爪！

12957.en: Masters of the trade belong to the Guild...
12957.zh: 這一行的頂尖好手都屬於公會……

13001.en: I'm Mick the Pick, baddest Rattkin in the land!
13001.zh: 我是撬鎖米克，全大地最狠的鼠人！

13011.en: Don Barlone' is head of the family of Razuka!
13011.zh: 唐·巴隆內是拉祖卡家族的首領！

13016.en: Ratsputin, the gathering paw of the Razuka!
13016.zh: 鼠拉斯普丁，拉祖卡的召集之爪！

13018.en: He's making the rounds, I'm sure!

13021.en: Bertie has lots of sharp goodies for sale...
13021.zh: 貝提有好多鋒利的好貨要賣……

13023.en: Bertie's shoppe, in our forest home...
13023.zh: 貝提的店，在我們的森林家園……

13026.en: Don't be fooled by Old Blindmeis, he's fastest Rattkin in the land!
13026.zh: 別被老盲麥斯騙了，他是全大地最快的鼠人！

13032.en: Our forest home in the northern lands...
13032.zh: 我們在北方的森林家園……

13033.en: In the woods, down the valley, through the vale, over the mountains!
13033.zh: 在林間，沿山谷而下，穿過溪谷，翻越群山！

13041.en: The old Funhouse, it's been closed since I can remember...
13041.zh: 老玩笑屋，自我有記憶以來就一直關著……

13043.en: The old Funhouse, on the south side of our forest home...
13043.zh: 老玩笑屋，在我們森林家園的南邊……

13046.en: Ratskell's has many unusual items for the fleet of hand!
13046.zh: 拉茨凱爾店裡有許多稀奇貨品，供巧手之人選購！

13048.en: Ratskell's shoppe is in our forest home...
13048.zh: 拉茨凱爾的店就在我們的森林家園……

13052.en: Old Blindmeis might be able to help you, heh heh...
13052.zh: 老盲麥斯或許能幫上你的忙，嘿嘿……

13056.en: The Razuka, the mighty paw of the land!
13056.zh: 拉祖卡，這片土地的威猛之爪！

13062.en: Masters of the trade belong to the Guild...
13062.zh: 這一行的頂尖好手都屬於公會……

13101.en: I am he called Kymas Turan, deliverer of the holy word of Dane!
13101.zh: 我是基馬斯圖蘭，丹恩聖言的傳道者！

13103.en: I travel the lands to help the wicked and sinful see the divine light!
13103.zh: 我行走各地，助惡人罪人看見神聖之光！

13111.en: The Magna Dane, ruler of the House of Dane!

13113.en: The Magna Dane rules from atop the Great Tower of Dane!
13113.zh: 大丹恩從丹恩大塔的塔頂統治！

13121.en: Brother Almagorte, welcomes new initiates into the House of Dane!
13121.zh: 阿爾馬戈特修士，迎接新入會者進入丹恩家！

13123.en: Brother Almagorte may be found in the Great Tower of Dane!
13123.zh: 阿爾馬戈特修士可在丹恩大塔找到！

13126.en: Speak kindly of the brother that helps all arise in the House of Dane!
13126.zh: 好好稱許那位幫助眾人在丹恩家晉升的修士！

13128.en: He travels the sacred halls of the Tower of Dane!
13128.zh: 他行走於丹恩大塔的聖堂！

13131.en: Brother Belcanzor helps those in need of special assistance...
13131.zh: 貝爾坎佐修士幫助需要特殊協助的人……

13133.en: The good brother Belcanzor is here and there, as he pleases...
13133.zh: 善良的貝爾坎佐修士隨心所至，四處雲遊……

13136.en: Dionysceus, the Great Tower, the House of Dane!
13136.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，巨塔，丹恩家！

13138.en: Dionysceus, the Great Tower which shadows the Myrmideon Forest...
13138.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，籠罩蜜爾米頓森林的巨塔……

13147.en: The holy House of Dane, the Great Tower of the Righteous!
13147.zh: 神聖的丹恩家，義者的巨塔！

13148.en: The House of Dane, the Great Tower of Dionysceus!
13148.zh: 丹恩家，狄奧尼修斯巨塔！

13151.en: Only the most deserved may hope to join the ranks of the High Fathers!
13151.zh: 唯有最夠資格者，方能冀望晉升高階神父之列！

13153.en: The High Fathers sit by the throne of the holy Magna Dane!
13153.zh: 高階神父們坐在神聖大丹恩的王座之旁！

13157.en: Those rising high in the House of Dane shall know great power!
13157.zh: 在丹恩家高升者，將知曉強大的力量！

13161.en: Speak not that sinful name, lest thee summon the Magna Dane!
13161.zh: 別提那罪惡之名，免得召來大丹恩！

13166.en: We seek to still the tongue of that drunken evil cur!
13166.zh: 我們要讓那醉鬼惡犬閉上嘴！

13171.en: Father Rulae, the unfortunate fool of the blaspheming Munk!
13171.zh: 魯萊神父，瀆神穆克的可憐蠢貨！

13173.en: They say he spreads the lies of Munk in the heart of New City...
13173.zh: 據說他在新城中心散播穆克的謊言……

13177.en: Let not the righteous set foot within that place of evil!
13177.zh: 義者切勿踏進那邪惡之地！

13182.en: By prophecy the world shall end and shallow the unrighteous!
13182.zh: 依預言，世界將終結，不義者將遭吞沒！

13187.en: Repent, O ye sinners! &Repent thy evil and wicked ways before the end!
13187.zh: 懺悔吧，罪人們！&在終末前懺悔你邪惡的行徑！

13191.en: May the divine light guide thee!

13301.en: I am Jan-Ette, of the Helazoid Legions...
13301.zh: 我是珍妮特，赫詹軍團的一員……

13303.en: I am searching for the sign of the coming of the Crusaders!
13303.zh: 我正在尋找十字軍降臨的預兆！

13311.en: Dame Ke-Li, the Queen of the City of Sky!
13311.zh: 柯麗夫人，天空之城的女王！

13313.en: Dame Ke-Li reigns over the City of Sky!
13313.zh: 柯麗夫人統治著天空之城！

13316.en: We are the Helazoid Legions, Defenders of the City of Sky!
13316.zh: 我們是赫詹軍團，天空之城的守護者！

13321.en: The Higardi were our distant ancestors, long ago disappeared...
13321.zh: 希加爾迪人是我們遙遠的祖先，早已消失……

13323.en: The Higardi left our world many years ago...
13323.zh: 希加爾迪人多年前離開了我們的世界……

13326.en: The City of Sky is the home of our Helazoid Legions...
13326.zh: 天空之城是我們赫詹軍團的家園……

13328.en: The City of Sky lies far to the south, across the great sea...
13328.zh: 天空之城在遙遠的南方，隔著大海……

13336.en: Only we of the Helazoid Legion may ride upon the flying steeds...
13336.zh: 只有我們赫詹軍團能乘飛天坐騎……

13338.en: We have many flying machines in the City of Sky!
13338.zh: 我們在天空之城有許多飛行機器！

13346.en: In the City of Sky there are many machines...
13346.zh: 天空之城裡有許多機器……

13351.en: We await the coming of the Crusaders!
13351.zh: 我們等候十字軍的降臨！

13356.en: By his name, surely you be the heralds of the prophecy!
13356.zh: 以他之名，你們必是預言的先驅！

13361.en: When the prophecy is complete, we shall sail into the heavens forever!
13361.zh: 預言完成之時，我們將永遠航向天際！

14001.en: !The complexities of life do distract and disorient, and thee shall
14001.zh: 人生的紛繁擾亂心神，你將

14002.en: know the turmoil of fear and uncertainty...
14002.zh: 飽嘗恐懼與迷惘的煎熬……

14003.en: @He that hath not foundation shall in wandering suffer...
14003.zh: 無有根基者，必在漂泊中受苦……

14004.en: @While he that hath sanctuary shall know peace and stability...
14004.zh: 有聖所可依者，方得安穩與平靜……

14005.en: @Discover thee the builder, that thee may light these eyes...
14005.zh: 尋得那位建造者，點亮這雙眼……

14006.en: @For rooted in he lies the knowledge of structure...
14006.zh: 因知識的根柢正立於他之中……

14007.en: @From encircling waters wrest thee the works of stones...
14007.zh: 自環繞的水中取出石之造物……

14008.en: @As thee make sacrifice twixt all the four corners, thy labor
14008.zh: 當你在四角之間獻上祭品，你的辛勞

14009.en: shall not be in vain, for the opaque yielded from the stone
14009.zh: 便不會白費——石中產出的渾濁

14010.en: will be transformed, and thee shall behold the radiant light...
14010.zh: 將被轉化，你將親見燦亮的光……

14011.en: @Thus may one discover a haven, and assuredly travel onward...
14011.zh: 如此，或能尋得避風港，篤定地繼續前行……

14012.en: @Thus may one discover thyself, and assuredly travel through life...
14012.zh: 如此，或能發現自我，篤定地走過人生……

14051.en: !The waters of life do move as the weather, and in life as the
14051.zh: 生命之水如天氣流轉，人生如水，

14052.en: waters, thee shall know both calm and storm...
14052.zh: 你將歷經風平浪靜與狂風暴雨……

14053.en: @He that must embrace the storm shall soon be swept away...
14053.zh: 擁抱風暴者，終將被席捲而去……

14054.en: @While he that learns to navigate, shall make his own journey...
14054.zh: 學會駕馭者，方能開創自己的航程……

14055.en: @When thy fear has turned to anger, thee has lost thy soul,
14055.zh: 當恐懼化作憤怒，你已失去靈魂，

14056.en: and shall make the devil laugh...

14057.en: @But to still thy tongue and become amazed, thee begets enlightenment,
14057.zh: 但若靜默不言、心懷驚奇，啟蒙便由此而生，

14058.en: and thus shall thee know bliss...

14059.en: @Thus may one discover a craft, and sail upon the waters...
14059.zh: 如此，或能尋得一葉扁舟，航行於水上……

14060.en: @Thus may one discover thyself, and sail upon life...
14060.zh: 如此，或能發現自我，航行於人生……

14101.en: !As the serpent winds and coils, so shall thy journey through life...
14101.zh: 蛇行蜿蜒盤繞，你的人生旅程亦然……

14102.en: @He that comprehends the serpent shall ascend its mighty towers...
14102.zh: 領悟蛇性者，將攀上它巍峨的高塔……

14103.en: @While he that sets forth unknowing shall but sail endlessly
14103.zh: 懵然啟程者，只會在迷雲之中

14104.en: within clouds of confusion and without enlightenment...

14105.en: @Thus may one engage the mists of darkness and glimpse the light,
14105.zh: 如此，或能撥開黑暗之霧，窺見光明，

14106.en: and recognize the harbour of his twining purpose...
14106.zh: 認出那盤繞己志的港灣……

14107.en: @Thus may one engage the mists of life and glimpse the light,
14107.zh: 如此，或能撥開人生之霧，窺見光明，

14108.en: and recognize the course of his twining destiny...
14108.zh: 認出那盤繞己命的航向……

14151.en: !Inside a dragon's lair doth Man wander, in pursuit of his
14151.zh: 人在龍穴中徘徊，追尋自我的

14152.en: fulfillment, a monster behind every shadow lurking...
14152.zh: 圓滿——每道陰影後都潛伏著怪物……

14153.en: @His inner dreams doth hunger for noble rewards, while his world
14153.zh: 內心的夢渴望著崇高的報償，眼前的世界

14154.en: doth comprise naught but fruitless conflict and frustration...
14154.zh: 卻盡是徒勞的衝突與挫折……

14155.en: @Only he that yet looks again at all he hath discovered, may
14155.zh: 唯有肯再度凝視自己所發現的一切者，

14156.en: find hidden the new meanings which lie concealed between the cracks
14156.zh: 才能在脆裂知識的縫隙間，

14158.en: @Thus may one brave the shadowy dragons, and discover the hidden
14158.zh: 如此，或能直面暗影之龍，

14159.zh: 發現迷宮中的隱藏寶藏……

14160.en: @Thus may one brave his shadowy fears, and discover the hidden
14160.zh: 如此，或能直面心中的暗影恐懼，

14201.en: !And a vat of slugs shall be her womb, for amongst the hideous and
14201.zh: 一甕蛞蝓將是她的子宮，因為她靈魂的種子

14202.en: foul doth the seed of her spirit lie waiting...
14202.zh: 正潛藏於醜惡與污穢之間……

14203.en: @From a bed of salt upon the pool of churning waters shall come the
14203.zh: 翻攪的水池上、鹽的溫床中，將誕生

14204.en: immaculate rebirth, and deliverance from the Sea of Chaos...
14204.zh: 無瑕的重生，自混沌之海獲得救贖……

14205.en: @So likened too is the life of man, born into a sea of strange
14205.zh: 人生亦復如是——生於陌生聲音之海，

14206.en: voices, living in the land of salt, forever searching for the
14206.zh: 活在鹽的國度，永遠尋覓那

14207.en: secret silent whisper that will ignite him, that he
14207.zh: 足以點燃自己的祕密低語，

14208.en: may open his eyes and stand free against the sky...
14208.zh: 好睜開雙眼，昂然挺立於天穹之下……

14210.en: and ascend from the bubbling turmoil...

14211.en: @Thus may one discover thyself, and ascend from the chaos of life...
14211.zh: 如此，或能發現自我，自人生的混沌中超脫……

14251.en: !In the land of the Dead shall thee travel, an isle of ghosts and
14251.zh: 你將踏入死亡之國——一座鬼魂與

14253.en: @For as thy knowledge be rooted in history past, thy thoughts shall
14253.zh: 你的知識既根植於逝去的歷史，思緒便只是

14254.en: be but echoes from the crypts of the lost and the dead...
14254.zh: 亡者墓穴中傳出的回聲……

14255.en: @They that stare blindly into the hall of the past shall see not...
14255.zh: 盲目凝視過往之殿者，將一無所見……

14256.en: @While he that stands aloof and notes carefully, shall find the
14256.zh: 超然佇立、細心觀察者，方能尋得

14257.en: secrets which lie nestled along its outskirting waters...
14257.zh: 沿著邊緣水路潛藏的祕密……

14258.en: @To embrace the dead as if truth, is to dwell in darkened crypts...
14258.zh: 把死者當真理來擁抱，便是幽居於黑暗墓穴……

14259.en: @To cast thine eyes upon the radiant sun, let this be thy truth...
14259.zh: 把目光投向燦亮的太陽——讓這成為你的真理……

14260.en: @Thus may one escape the crypt, and depart the island cube...
14260.zh: 如此，或能逃出墓穴，離開這方島嶼立方……

14261.en: @Thus may one escape the past, and depart the island mind...
14261.zh: 如此，或能掙脫過往，離開這座心的孤島……

14301.en: !Whatever was written upon the map has long ago faded...
14301.zh: 地圖上曾寫下的字跡早已褪去……

21070.zh: 從這場奇蹟似的飛行中站起身，你感覺體重

21076.zh: 彩色的圓圈和一顆星星……

21080.en: Grabbing onto the rope so conveniently dangling from above, your
21080.zh: 抓住頭頂正好垂下的繩索，擺盪的動能

21081.en: momentum swings you across the water duct...

21085.zh: 踏板上放著一顆古怪的黑球，

21086.en: about the size of an ogre's head and almost as pretty...
21086.zh: 約莫食人魔腦袋大小，長得也差不多……

21090.zh: 你面前的地板上有一塊方形踏板，

21091.en: for everyone to crowd onto it...

21092.en: @Behind the plate you can see the outline of a transparent tube,
21092.zh: 踏板後方，可以看到一根透明管子的輪廓，

21093.en: sticking down from a shaft in the ceiling...
21093.zh: 從天花板的豎井裡伸下來……

21095.en: Stepping onto the plate, you note the pad directly underneath
21095.zh: 踏上踏板，你注意到墊子的正上方是

21100.en: Inspecting the tube, you see the pad underneath it
21100.zh: 檢視那根管子——下方的墊子

21101.en: is poised to catch anything that falls down the chute...
21101.zh: 擺好了位置，要接住任何從豎井落下的東西……

21110.en: Stepping onto the plate, you hear a slight click... &%]
21110.zh: 踏上踏板，你聽見輕輕的喀噠聲……&%]

21111.en: A large black ball drops down the hollow tube, landing
21111.zh: 一顆巨大的黑球沿著中空管落下，

21115.en: Suddenly the entire plate shoots skyward, propelling you up the
21115.zh: 突然整塊踏板衝天而起，把你們

21116.zh: 沿著頭頂敞開的豎井拋了上去……

21120.en: You fall back through the shaft and land with a crash upon the
21120.zh: 你們沿豎井跌回，重重砸在

21125.en: Coiled in the corner you discover a short thick rope, which is
21125.zh: 角落裡盤著一小段粗繩，

21126.en: securely tied to a hefty bar...

21140.en: Upon the wall is a set of tall metal spears, mounted in a single row
21140.zh: 牆上裝著一組高大的金屬矛，排成單列

21141.en: with a long rivet through the center...

21142.en: @There are six spears in all, arranged in a circular pattern,
21142.zh: 總共六支長矛，排成圓形，

21143.en: and you discover that they can swing around on the rivet which
21143.zh: 你發現它們可以繞著固定的鉚釘轉動……

21145.en: @Looking a bit closer, it appears to be an elaborate mechanism of
21145.zh: 仔細一看，這像是某種精巧的機關——

21146.en: some kind, each spear rotating a different gear which is in turn
21146.zh: 每支長矛轉動不同的齒輪，齒輪又

21147.en: connected to more gears and so on...
21147.zh: 連著更多齒輪，層層相扣……

21148.en: @There is nothing which indicates a purpose to the spears, or
21148.zh: 沒有任何東西說明這些長矛的用途，

21149.en: what the contraption actually does, although it appears likely
21149.zh: 也不知道這玩意到底做什麼——但看起來

21150.en: that it is a locking mechanism of some kind, designed to open

21151.en: if the spears are turned in a specific combination...
21151.zh: 要把長矛轉到特定組合才會開啟……

21160.en: Lo, inside the chest you find an old preserved piece of
21160.zh: 看，寶箱裡有一張保存良好的

21161.en: parchment, carefully bundled in waxed wrappings...
21161.zh: 古老羊皮紙，仔細裹在蠟紙裡……

21165.en: Lo, inside the chest is naught but a pile of empty wax wrapping...
21165.zh: 看哪，箱中別無他物，只有一堆空蠟包裝……

21170.en: You emerge from the Funhouse to find yourself in the forest,
21170.zh: 走出玩笑屋，你發現自己在森林裡，

21171.en: somewhere outside the nearby Rattkin ruins...

21175.en: The forest has grown through the cumbling ruins, and appears to
21175.zh: 森林早已長過傾頹的遺跡，

21176.en: have choked off the main entry...
21176.zh: 把主要入口堵了個嚴實……

21180.en: Passing the tree, you notice that an anomaly of nature has arranged
21180.zh: 經過那棵樹時，你注意到造化的奇手把

21181.en: the gnarls and knots of its rippled bark into the likeness of a face,
21181.zh: 它波紋狀樹皮上的樹瘤與節疤排成了一張臉，

21182.en: and one that possesses a gloaty smug smile at that...
21182.zh: 而且那張臉還帶著一抹自鳴得意的奸笑……

21185.en: It is then that you witness the woody countenance make a wink, and
21185.zh: 就在此時，你親眼見到那張木臉眨了眨眼，而

21186.en: momentarily numbed by the surprising event, find yourself seized
21186.zh: 被這突如其來的變故驚得一呆，發現自己已被

21187.zh: 牢牢地困在它緊抓的枝椏之中……

21190.en: Before you can react, you are hoisted up into the tree, shuffled
21190.zh: 你還來不及反應，就被高高舉上樹，一路

21191.en: and passed from branch to branch, and finally deposited into a
21191.zh: 在枝椏間被傳來傳去，最後被安置進一間

21192.en: crude and weathered bungalow, apparently either built into the
21192.zh: 簡陋而飽經風霜的小屋，它顯然要不是嵌在

21193.en: top of the tree or overhanging it in some fashion...
21193.zh: 樹頂，就是以某種方式懸挑在樹上……

21205.en: The squat furry Rattkins seemed most surprised and disturbed by your
21205.zh: 這群矮胖多毛的鼠人似乎大為驚愕，被你

21206.en: appearance, and no doubt word of your arrival is quickly spreading
21206.zh: 的現身攪得心神不寧，你到來的消息無疑正迅速傳遍

21210.en: Passing by the gnarled faced tree, its makes a sly wink, seizing
21210.zh: 經過那棵瘤臉怪樹時，它狡黠地眨眨眼，用

21211.en: you within its grasping branches and hoisting you up...
21211.zh: 緊抓的枝椏捉住你，把你高高舉起……

21215.en: Grabbing onto the branches at the top of the tree, you climb down
21215.zh: 抓住樹頂的枝椏，你一路向下爬

21305.en: There is a steep trail which leads up the mountain here...
21305.zh: 此處有一條陡峭的小徑通往山上……

21315.en: There is a steep trail which leads down the mountain here...
21315.zh: 此處有一條陡峭的小徑通往山下……

21320.zh: 你靈巧地通過了這段兇險的攀爬……

21330.en: You are standing atop a sheer cliff, and below you the trees of
21330.zh: 你站在峭壁的頂端，腳下森林的樹木

21331.en: the forest appear as little specks, a pool of emerald lawn...
21331.zh: 看來如同細小的斑點，宛如一池翠綠草地……

21335.en: The craggy face of the mountain side offers little hope of being
21335.zh: 山壁嶙峋崎嶇，幾乎毫無

21336.en: scaled, but upon closer scrutiny you discover a rotted piece of
21336.zh: 攀爬的可能，但細看之下，你發現一段腐朽的

21337.en: rope, lassoed around a boulder and dangling down the precipice,
21337.zh: 繩索，套繫在巨石上垂下絕壁，

21338.en: suggesting that someone has attempted the descent before...
21338.zh: 顯示先前曾有人嘗試由此而下……

21339.en: @Unfortunately, the dried rope crumbles at the touch, eliminating
21339.zh: 可惜，乾枯的繩子一碰就碎，

21340.en: it as a viable means of support...
21340.zh: 無法再作為可靠的支撐……

21345.en: Securing the long cord of spliced vines to a boulder at the cliff's
21345.zh: 你把拼接藤蔓製成的長繩固定在崖邊

21346.en: edge, you peer down and notice that it seems to reach the ground...
21346.zh: 的巨石上，往下看去，繩子似乎能及地……

21347.en: @It sure looked alot further a few moments ago...
21347.zh: 方才看起來明明還遠得多……

21350.en: Dropping the vine down the side of the cliff, you see that it is
21350.zh: 把藤蔓沿峭壁放下去，你發現它

21351.en: still too short to reach the forest below...
21351.zh: 仍然太短，搆不到下方的森林……

21365.en: At the base of a sheer cliff dangles a long vine from far above...
21365.zh: 峭壁腳下，一條長藤自高處垂落……

21375.en: A long vine dangles down the sheer cliff into the forest below...
21375.zh: 一條長藤沿峭壁垂入下方森林……

21380.en: You stand at the base of a steep sheer cliff, almost straight up
21380.zh: 你站在陡峭絕壁的腳下，它近乎垂直

21381.en: and certainly impossible to scale or climb...

21382.en: @It appears to ascend all the way into the heavens...
21382.zh: 它看上去一路直上雲霄……

21390.en: With grim determination amidst visions of a pulpy death, you
21390.zh: 腦中閃過摔成肉泥的畫面，你仍狠下決心，

21391.zh: 勇敢地展開這場不可思議的攀登……

21405.en: From a tree hang long thick vines, growing across
21405.zh: 一棵樹上垂掛著粗長的藤蔓，一路蔓生過

21406.en: the ground and up the mountain, hundreds of feet long...
21406.zh: 地面又攀上山坡，長達數百英尺……

21410.en: The vines appear supple and sturdy, but cling so gently to the
21410.zh: 藤蔓看似柔韌結實，卻只是輕輕攀附在

21411.en: mountain face that a quick yank parts them from their grasp,
21411.zh: 山壁上，使勁一扯便讓它們鬆開了攀附，

21412.en: tumbling them back upon you to the ground in a heap...
21412.zh: 整堆塌落下來砸在你身上，摔到地面……

21450.en: A sudden cold chill rushes through you as you come to the edge
21450.zh: 走到一片林間空地的邊緣時，一陣寒意

21451.en: of a clearing in the forest...

21455.en: The night air cackles with an eerie magic, the wind howls, and you
21455.zh: 夜空嘶響著詭異的魔法，風聲嚎嘯，你

21456.en: understand well these signs that signify you stand amidst the presence
21456.zh: 深知這些徵兆表示你正置身於某種

21460.en: You enter a cold spot, which momentarily dances around
21460.zh: 你走進一團寒氣之中，它繞著

21465.en: Peering through the lens of the Necromatic Helm, you stand witness
21465.zh: 透過死靈頭盔的鏡片凝望，你親眼目睹

21466.en: to a host of colorful ghostly visages as they dance and dart
21466.zh: 成群色彩繽紛的幽靈面容，正飛舞穿梭

21467.zh: 在這片超自然的場域之間……

21468.en: @They seem to be encircling something, and you notice that
21468.zh: 它們似乎正圍繞著某個東西，而且你注意到

21469.en: they make occasional thrusts and lunges into the center of the
21469.zh: 它們不時朝著圈中央突刺猛撲，

21470.en: circle, which is immediately followed by an anguished scream of
21470.zh: 而每次之後立刻響起一聲悽厲的

21471.en: pain, coming from as yet some unknown other creature...
21471.zh: 痛苦慘叫，來自某個尚未現身的生物……

21475.en: You draw near to one of the faint spectres, who menacingly turns
21475.zh: 你朝其中一個黯淡的幽魂靠近，它帶著威嚇

21481.en: I am it that the East Witch tolls; &%]
21481.zh: 我是東方女巫敲響的鐘；&%]

21482.en: By ears of gold her wish be done, &
21482.zh: 憑金色耳朵遂她的心願，&

21483.en: Tis Barbana called in mountains yon!
21483.zh: 山那一方，她名喚芭芭娜！

21486.en: I am it that the West Witch dooms; &%]
21486.zh: 我是西方女巫降下的厄運；&%]

21487.en: By a nose of gold her wish be done, &
21487.zh: 憑金色鼻子遂她的心願，&

21488.en: Tis Carmela called in mountains yon!
21488.zh: 山那一方，她名喚卡蜜拉！

21490.en: Blackened chains on dead men's veins, &
21490.zh: 死人血管上的焦黑鎖鏈，&

21491.en: I am it that the South Witch banes; &%]
21491.zh: 我是南方女巫降的禍殃；&%]

21492.en: By teeth of gold her wish be done, &
21492.zh: 憑金色牙齒遂她的心願，&

21493.en: Tis Xandasa called in mountains yon!
21493.zh: 山那一方，她名喚珊達莎！

21496.en: I am it that the North Witch sires; &%]
21496.zh: 我是北方女巫所出之物；&%]

21497.en: By eyes of gold her wish be done, &
21497.zh: 憑金色眼睛遂她的心願，&

21498.en: Tis Naralda called in mountains yon!
21498.zh: 山那一方，她名喚娜拉爾達！

21500.en: Inside the circle of dancing wraiths, another spirit fades into view...
21500.zh: 在飛舞群鬼圍成的圓圈中央，又一個靈影淡現而出……

21505.en: Her frail and noble body shaking, she calls... &%]
21505.zh: 她纖弱而高貴的身軀顫抖著，呼喊……&%]

21507.en: The ghastly phantasms suddenly leap and tear at her, and you watch
21507.zh: 兇惡的幽靈們突然撲上撕扯她，你只能眼睜睜

21508.en: helplessly as she writhes at their touch, fading again out of view...
21508.zh: 看著她在觸碰下扭動掙扎，再度淡出視線……

21510.en: Suddenly in the sky you see a soaring black bird, pursued by a flock
21510.zh: 突然間，你望見天上一隻翱翔的黑鳥，身後有

21511.zh: 一群魔性飛獸緊追在後……

21512.en: @The black bird descends upon you with a telling pain that speaks all
21512.zh: 黑鳥朝你撲降而下，帶著一股痛楚，

21513.en: too well of its desperate plight...
21513.zh: 將牠絕望的處境訴說得再清楚不過……

21515.en: Stopping just before you, the doomed bird looks into your face and
21515.zh: 那隻劫數難逃的鳥兒停在你面前，望著你的臉，

21516.en: attempts to croan out something which you might understand... &%]
21516.zh: 努力嘶啞地叫出你也許能懂的話……&%]

21518.en: Then it is off again, and you watch as its pursuers quickly gain, and
21518.zh: 接著牠又騰身而去，你看著追兵迅速逼近，

21519.en: know that it is only a short matter of time before they succeed in
21519.zh: 明白不出多久，他們終將

21530.en: The pointed spires of scowling black mountains loom upwards, towering
21530.zh: 森然黑山的尖銳峰巒向上高聳，

21531.en: into the sky, and you feel a sudden slight rush of both awe and
21531.zh: 直插天際，你心中驟然湧起一股敬畏

21535.en: The royal peaks of the thick Ukpyr Mountains lying east shine in hues
21535.zh: 東邊巍峨的烏克皮爾山脈，王者般的群峰閃著

21536.en: of deep purple-blue, its forested foothills made serene by the
21536.zh: 深紫藍的色澤，覆滿林木的山麓因

21537.en: colors of wild flowers dotting the velveted shore...
21537.zh: 野花點綴如絨毯的岸邊而寧靜祥和……

21540.en: Ascending into the dark sable crown of the Witch Mountains, you feel
21540.zh: 登上有如漆黑王冠的巫女山脈，你感覺

21541.en: as if about to set foot upon an etherial stage of unnatural forces...
21541.zh: 自己彷彿即將踏上超自然力量的虛幻舞台……

21545.en: A soft apparition appears upon the mountainside... &%]
21545.zh: 一道輕柔的幽影浮現在山腰上……&%]

21546.en: She pauses momentarily, gazing in your direction... &%]
21546.zh: 她停留片刻，朝你的方向凝望……&%]

21547.en: There is something she is holding in her hands... &%]
21547.zh: 她手中似乎捧著什麼東西……&%]

21548.en: Then she turns away, and soon vanishes without a trace...
21548.zh: 然後她轉身離去，不久便消失得無影無蹤……

21560.en: You see a moving swarm of dainty glowing lights up ahead...
21560.zh: 你看見前方有一群翩然移動的小光點……

21565.en: The little lights seem to be moving, always ahead of you...
21565.zh: 那些小光點似乎一直在移動，始終在你前方……

21570.en: The tiny lights have disappeared into the darkness...
21570.zh: 微小的光點已消失在黑暗之中……

21572.en: From out of the darkness the swarming stars engulf you!
21572.zh: 成群光點從黑暗中湧出，將你吞噬！

21575.en: A cold shiver suddenly passes through you... %]
21575.zh: 一陣寒顫突然掠過你身……%]

21577.en: It must have been only the wind... %]

21578.en: But it has left you feeling cold, so cold...
21578.zh: 但它留下了寒意，冷，好冷……

21580.en: Before you appears a shackled ghost... &%]
21580.zh: 你面前出現一個被鐵鍊鎖住的幽靈……&%]

21582.en: As if wanting something from you... &%]

21583.en: Then it becomes angry and charges, a grimacing demon... &%]
21583.zh: 接著它獰笑暴怒，如惡魔般撲來……&%]

21584.en: Its face becomes like death and it enters into you... &%]
21584.zh: 它的面容變得如死亡般，接著竄入你體內……&%]

21585.en: Only to disappear and leave you cold, so very cold...
21585.zh: 隨即消失無蹤，只留給你寒意，刺骨的冷……

21590.en: A strange sound can be heard from somewhere distant... %]
21590.zh: 遠處某處傳來一陣奇異的聲響……%]

21591.en: It sounds like a woman, crying... %]

21592.en: Then it sounds like it is calling out to someone... %]
21592.zh: 接著又像是在呼喚某人……%]

21593.en: And then turns into a spoken whisper... %]

21594.en: But it is too faint for you to make out the words...
21594.zh: 但聲音太微弱，你聽不清說的是什麼……

21601.en: !Once upon a time there was a goodly witch by the name of
21601.zh: 很久以前，有位善良的女巫，名叫

21602.en: Hilynda, who was very powerful and beautiful. She lived high
21602.zh: 希琳達，她法力高強，容貌美麗。她住在

21603.en: upon a mountain top, and ruled all the lands below her as far as
21603.zh: 高高的山頂上，統治山下凡視線所及的一切土地。

21604.en: the eye could see. Being a fair and just witch, she was provider
21604.zh: 她公正又仁慈，是領地中所有動物的

21605.en: and benefactor to all the animals dwelling within her domain,
21605.zh: 供養者與恩主，也常在路過的旅人

21606.en: and often appeared to passing strangers in times of need. She
21606.zh: 危難之時現身相助。她的父母

21607.en: had been borne of parents who also were witches, and had inherited
21607.zh: 也是女巫，她因此繼承了預知

21608.en: the power to foretell the future, a very rare and special gift, even
21608.zh: 未來的能力，那是極罕見的特別天賦，

21609.en: for a witch. But coming from a family of witches, she was not an
21609.zh: 就連對女巫而言也是。但生於女巫之家，她

21610.en: only child. Four sisters, envious of her beauty and jealous of her
21610.zh: 並非獨生女。四個姊妹嫉妒她的美貌、

21611.en: power, also lived in the mountains. And as every day passed, they
21611.zh: 眼紅她的力量，也住在山中。隨著日子

21612.en: became more and more resentful of her popularity and her goodness.
21612.zh: 一天天過去，她們對她的名望與善良越發怨恨。

21613.en: So the four sisters banded together, and decided that they would
21613.zh: 於是四姊妹結成一夥，決定要

21614.en: undo all the good that Hilynda had done, and torment her, and
21614.zh: 破壞希琳達成就的一切善行，折磨她，

21615.en: be just as nasty as they could. And the four sisters took upon
